title: Run usage
description: What a run cost, appended to the answer as its own object by the code that made the model calls. NO MODEL PRODUCES THIS: the call count and the token counts are counted from the framework's own reports as the calls are made, and the deployment name and the prompt version are configuration. It is a separate object rather than a field of the result because the model's answer is streamed verbatim and a figure added afterwards cannot be injected into an object that has already been sent.

modelCalls.description: How many model calls the run made. COUNTED, never estimated: two on a clean run, three if a repair loop is added.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens the clients reported, summed over the run.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens the clients reported, summed over the run.

model.description: The deployment that answered, read from AZURE_AI_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT_NAME.

promptVersion.description: Every prompt the run used, joined with '+', derived from the prompt file names so nothing has to be remembered when one is revised.
